title: fix(data-objectstack): ObjectStackAdapter reads baseUrl as the server origin, so a base ending in /api/vN reaches discovery; the objectui skill teaches the origin
body:
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_ Fixes #27774 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:`ObjectStackAdapter` 构造时把 `baseUrl` 一次归一为服务器 origin(去掉尾部 `/` 与尾部 `/api/vN`),发现请求、内嵌 `ObjectStackClient` 的路由与适配器各处裸读共用这一个值;原来五处逐调用的后缀判断删掉。objectui 技能的两份指南与包 README 改教 origin 形式(同源代理写 `''`),data-integration eval 拒绝旧写法 `baseUrl: '/api/v1'`。 - 为什么改:技能教的 `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` 让发现请求打到 `/api/v1/api/v1/discovery`,`connect()` 失败,之后每次读写随之失败。适配器自己的搜索/数据/导出/元数据裸读早已去掉该后缀,但发现请求与内嵌 client 没有;只改发现一行,client 路由的读(如 `/api/v1/meta/:type`)仍会翻倍,所以归一放在构造处。 - 风险与回滚:URL 拼装只在 `@object-ui/data-objectstack` 一个包变化;origin 形式的 URL 字节不变(全包 104 个测试文件 1228 用例绿);回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移,无 spec 改动。 - 先看:`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `serverOriginOf` 与构造函数 hunk;`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`;`skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json`。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/connectBaseUrlApiSuffix-27774.test.ts`,预期 7 passed;同一文件对 `origin/main` 跑是 4 failed(断言里出现 `/api/v1/api/v1/discovery`)。 - 需要你做的:Tier H(`skills/**`)—— 席位 ACCEPT 与合约复核 PASS 之后,由你合并或入队(或 os-zhuang / hotlong 的授权批准后由席位落地)。 ## What changes **Adapter (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`)** - `ObjectStackAdapter` reads `baseUrl` as the server origin ONCE, where it and its `ObjectStackClient` are built (`serverOriginOf`): a trailing slash and a trailing `/api/vN` are dropped. `''`, `http://host:3000`, `/api/v1` and `http://host:3000/api/v1` now all reach `/api/v1/discovery` and the same `/api/v1/...` routes, through the client and through the adapter's raw reads alike. - The five per-call `hasApiVersionSuffix` checks (search, data, export, two meta reads) are gone; each site joins `/api/v1/...` onto the normalised base. The analytics dataset query and the approvals reads, which joined onto the base as given, are covered by the same normalisation without a change of their own. - `baseUrl` on the constructor options carries a doc comment naming the form. - New pin `connectBaseUrlApiSuffix-27774.test.ts`: the discovery URL the injected fetch receives for the origin, the empty same-origin base, a relative and an absolute base ending in `/api/v1`, a trailing slash after it, a non-version path prefix (kept), and one client-routed read (`listMetadataItems`) from an `/api/v1` base that must reach `/api/v1/meta/position` once. **Skill (`skills/objectui`, governed, Tier H) and README** - `guides/data-integration.md`: the four adapter examples teach `baseUrl: ''` (the first one names the two forms: `''` behind a same-origin proxy, or the server origin); the constructor-options comment says the adapter adds `/api/v1`. - `guides/auth-permissions.md`: the one adapter example teaches `baseUrl: ''`. This file was not on the claim's declared surface; it is the fifth site of the same defect and the card's acceptance grep (`git grep -n "baseUrl: '/api/v1'" -- skills` is 0 hits) cannot pass without it. - `evals/data-integration.json`: eval 2 (building the frontend before the backend) expects the adapter to be handed the origin and refuses an answer containing `baseUrl: '/api/v1` (the wrong form's prefix, so the acceptance grep stays at 0 hits). - `ui/packages/data-objectstack/README.md`: the one `ObjectStackAdapter` example that taught `/api/v1` now teaches `''`. Its `MetadataClient` examples keep `/api/v1`: that class already collapses the suffix itself. **Changeset**: `.changeset/27774-adapter-base-url-origin.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@objectstack/skills`. ## Why A customer agent that loads the published `objectui` skill and wires a real backend was told to write `new ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' })`. Discovery joined `/api/v1/discovery` onto the base as given, so the first request asked for `/api/v1/api/v1/discovery`, `connect()` failed, and every read and write that awaits it failed with it. The triage ruled platform first: the adapter accepts both spellings (its sibling reads already did), pinned, and the skill then teaches the origin form `ObjectStackClient` takes. **Mechanism assumption re-measured.** The order assumed a strip on the discovery line alone, like the four sibling reads. Read from source: the adapter spreads its whole config into `new ObjectStackClient({ ...config })`, and the client joins every conventional route (`/api/v1/meta`, `/api/v1/data`, ...) onto ITS base as given, so a discovery-only strip would have connected and then doubled every client-routed read. The normalisation therefore sits in the constructor, before the client is built, and the pin's last case reads a client-routed URL. Same ruling, one step earlier. ## Tests Package tests and type-check, under the shared verify lock, on `e73e6d45`:
pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/ — Test Files 104 passed (104) · Tests 1228 passed (1228) · exit 0 ``` Test Files 104 passed (104) Tests 1228 passed (1228) ```
pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check — exit 0 ``` > @object-ui/data-objectstack@18.2.0 type-check > tsc --noEmit ```
**Red on the pre-fix adapter, green on the fix** (one leg each, the pre-fix `index.ts` restored from the merge base `ed0e71db` and put back with `git checkout HEAD -- …`; blob hash equal before and after, `git diff HEAD` empty):
pre-fix: Tests 4 failed | 3 passed (7) ``` × connects from a relative base ending in /api/v1 × connects from an absolute base ending in /api/v1 × connects from a base ending in /api/v1 and a trailing slash × routes a client read through the same base once, not /api/v1/api/v1 AssertionError: expected [ '/api/v1/api/v1/discovery' ] to deeply equal [ '/api/v1/discovery' ] Test Files 1 failed (1) Tests 4 failed | 3 passed (7) ```
fix: Tests 7 passed (7) ``` Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 7 passed (7) ```
The three origin-form cases pass on both trees: the origin spelling's bytes do not change. ## Acceptance notes - `git grep -n "baseUrl: '/api/v1'" -- skills` → 0 hits on this head (the card's acceptance line). - **Skill size, two readings, lines and ratchet tokens (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, the convention `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints):** - `guides/data-integration.md`: 480 → 480 lines · 4303 → 4328 tokens (ceiling 4451). - `guides/auth-permissions.md`: 416 → 416 lines · 3866 → 3864 tokens (ceiling 3866, headroom was 0; a comment there was dropped to stay under it). - `evals/data-integration.json`: 54 → 55 lines · 466 → 470 tokens (ceiling 471; the new refusal string is paid for by a shorter `expected_output` in the same file). - Whole `skills/objectui` bundle: 5416 → 5417 lines. Whole published catalog, the ratchet's "ratcheted (authored)" total: 208049 → 208079 tokens of 217809. No ceiling moved. - `baseUrl` ending in `/api/v2` is read as the origin too (the siblings' regex, kept); every route is then `/api/v1/...`. Not pinned: there is no v2 API to teach. - The shared discovery cache is keyed by the normalised origin, so `'/api/v1'` and `''` on one page share one discovery read, as they should. - Not changed, noted: `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` teaches `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api/v1` as an env example without wiring it into the adapter; with this PR that value would work either way. `MetadataClient` (same package) already collapses a `/api/v1` base; its README examples are left as they are. Neither is a card. - Seat 4's regions in `index.ts` (field-access fields, `dropInflightReads`, `getRecordFieldAccess`) are untouched; PR #27907's file list does not include this file. ## Verification - Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, off the merge base, head `e73e6d45`): 58 derived, 57 run with exit 0 (`node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` among them; `check:skill-examples` first refused on a missing `client-react` dist and passed after that package was built), 1 NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 here (it reads every package's dist, and this worktree holds only the adapter's dependency closure) and is declared to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`. `--ran` reconciliation: 58 accounted, 0 UNRUN; each exit code is in the `os-dev-report` comment on #27774. - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack lint` exit 0 (0 errors; the warnings it prints are pre-existing `any`s, none on a changed line). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. - Changed lines vs the merge base: 186 (+143 / −43), under the 3000 human-merge threshold. Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; package lint run (see Verification). - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a, not touched. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer digest the dispatch asks for, in Chinese by rule). - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01Utp6CXqKgaNYFmpss9BkRj)_
